assets.prompt: Exact text-free scientific diagram: A red atom pair and a blue atom pair sit to the left of a rightward arrow.

assets.caption: Reactants are substances that participate as inputs in a reaction. A reactant can remain in excess; reactions need not consume every starting particle. This is an unnamed particle model.

assets.caption: Products are substances formed by a reaction. A product substance could also have been present initially; “product” describes its role, not that it exists only afterward.
